items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Papaya Teo was living in La Hoppe and Durban... We was right there in the neighborhood. Half a block and a block apart.

ctx.x: I don't like to bother you with all those details but if we can figure out where some of those fellas lived. Like Big I. Now what corner was that on about? Which street? Like Big Iloy. Just which street?

Prairie between La Perouse and Unzago. Then I was on Prairie between La Perouse and La Hoppe. You see he was to that block and I was to this block. Papaya Teo was living in La Hoppe and Durban. Lorenzo Teo was living on Columbus between Prairie and Roman. And Pico. Where was Pico? Pico was living on Johnson near St. Bernard. We was right there in the neighborhood. Half a block and a block apart.
When did you take up music? How old were you about?
